# registry_module_scan (Data Source)

Fetches the most recent security scan result for a specific module version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "registry_module_scan" "vpc" {
  namespace = "my-org"
  name      = "vpc"
  system    = "aws"
  version   = "1.2.0"
}

output "vpc_scan_passed" {
  value = data.registry_module_scan.vpc.passed
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Module name.
- `namespace` (String) Module namespace.
- `system` (String) Module system.
- `version` (String) Module version.

### Read-Only

- `completed_at` (String) ISO 8601 completion timestamp.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 creation timestamp.
- `execution_log` (String) Raw scanner output.
- `findings` (Attributes List) Security findings from the scan. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--findings))
- `id` (String) UUID of the scan.
- `passed` (Boolean) Whether the scan passed.
- `scanner` (String) Scanner tool name.
- `started_at` (String) ISO 8601 start timestamp.
- `status` (String) Scan status.

<a id="nestedatt--findings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `findings`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Finding description.
- `file_path` (String) Source file path.
- `id` (String) UUID of the finding.
- `line_number` (Number) Line number in the source file.
- `resource` (String) Affected resource name.
- `rule_id` (String) Rule identifier.
- `severity` (String) Finding severity.
- `title` (String) Finding title.
